definitions.explanation: A factor already present that makes something likely to happen, especially an inherited or bodily tendency toward a disease. A formal word found mainly in medicine, psychology and analytical writing.

examples.japanese: {遺伝的|いでんてき}な{素因|そいん}。
⟦アレルギー→アレルギー：04645_arerugii⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧やすい{素因|そいん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: He has a predisposition to allergies.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{素因|そいん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{生活習慣|せいかつしゅうかん}→生活習慣：19568_seikatsushuukan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重|かさ}なって→重なる：02038_kasanaru⟧⟦{発症|はっしょう}する→発症する：22367_hasshousuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{考|かんが}えられている→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: This illness is thought to develop when lifestyle habits combine with an underlying predisposition.

notes:
USAGE:
In medicine {素因|そいん} (the patient's own tendency) is often paired with {誘因|ゆういん} (the trigger that sets the illness off).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {遺伝的|いでんてき}{素因|そいん}: genetic predisposition
- {素因|そいん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have a predisposition
- {素因|そいん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to be an underlying cause

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧: cause (the everyday word)
- ⟦{要因|よういん}→要因：05581_youin⟧: factor, one of several causes
- ⟦{体質|たいしつ}→体質：08243_taishitsu⟧: constitution, bodily tendency (everyday)
- Not to be confused with ⟦{素因数|そいんすう}→素因数：30120_soinsuu⟧ (prime factor), a mathematics term.
